hero.title: WELCOME TO IQAC
hero.subtitle: Your guide to understanding the IQAC system, your responsibilities, and the audit cycle.

section_1.title: 01 — WHAT?
section_1.headline: Before you manage the process, understand the system.
beats: What is IQAC? — Use institution-approved wording if available; otherwise keep the explanation high-level.
Why does it exist? — Show activity → evidence → review/audit → observation → correction/improvement → preserved learning.
Where does it sit? — Show the wider quality context and department-level IQAC. Use verified institutional names only.
What is a SPOC? — Present the SPOC as a coordination point for collection, tracking, verification, communication, audit preparation and follow-through.
What does a SPOC do? — UNDERSTAND → COLLECT → TRACK → VERIFY → COORDINATE → CARRY FORWARD.
section_1.implementation: Motion-graphic/video-style sequence. If no actual video is supplied, create it with HTML/CSS/SVG/Motion.

section_2.title: 02 — WHEN?
section_2.headline: See IQAC across the academic year.
section_2.critical_rule: Only events. NO stakeholders, NO relationship lines, NO interaction spaghetti.
section_2.audit_rule: The four audit milestones are a prototype annual representation. Exact dates/cadence remain configurable unless institutionally confirmed.

section_3.title: 03 — WHAT DO I OWN?
section_3.headline: Know what evidence lives inside the IQAC task list.
section_3.interaction: Click one of eight slab-attached section cards; open a compact detail panel showing subsections and configurable responsibility/deadline/status.

section_4.title: 04 — THEN WHAT?
section_4.headline: Follow the audit from start to carry-forward.
